question: Should every Android ClawSegmentedControl with more than four options wrap into balanced rows, or should wrapping remain local to the Skill Workshop filter surface?
rationale: Both approaches solve the proven truncation, but the PR changes a shared design-system interaction contract and the available evidence does not establish that other callers should inherit it.

options.title: Scope Wrapping Locally
options.body: Keep the shared segmented control's existing single-row contract and introduce the wrapping layout at the Skill Workshop filter caller.

options.title: Adopt Shared Wrapping
options.body: Make balanced multi-row layout the documented shared contract and verify representative sibling callers after rebasing onto current main.

recommendation.title: Scope Wrapping Locally
recommendation.body: Keep the shared segmented control's existing single-row contract and introduce the wrapping layout at the Skill Workshop filter caller.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository identifies this handle as the Android maintainer responsible for the affected shared component surface.
